Uses decoupled temporal-spatial aggregation to combine information from adjacent points and frames while retaining real-time rendering.
papers.title: DN-4DGS: Denoised Deformable Network with Temporal-Spatial Aggregation for Dynamic Scene Rendering

key_contributions: Connects language queries to a dynamic Gaussian representation of the world.
Demonstrates the system on public 3D video datasets of people and animals performing various actions.
Shows how to lift spatio-temporal features to a 4D representation based on 3D Gaussian Splatting.
papers.title: 4-LEGS: 4D Language Embedded Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Reconstructs an animatable head avatar from one image by predicting 3D Gaussian parameters in one forward pass.
Introduces dual lifting to create identity- and facial-detail-preserving Gaussians from image and 3D morphable-model features.
Supports unseen identities without per-subject optimization and real-time expression reenactment.
papers.title: Generalizable and Animatable Gaussian Head Avatar

key_contributions: Separates optical flow into camera-induced and object-motion components to obtain explicit motion supervision.
Uses the object-motion flow to guide Gaussian deformation and reduce ambiguity in monocular dynamic reconstruction.
Alternates camera-pose and Gaussian optimization to improve both motion estimation and novel-view synthesis.
papers.title: MotionGS: Exploring Explicit Motion Guidance for Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Drawing inspiration from modern 3D animation pipelines, the paper introduces DreamMesh4D, a novel framework combining mesh representation with geometric skinning technique to generate high-quality 4D object from a monocular video.
Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance of the method.
Instead of utilizing classical texture map for appearance, the method binds Gaussian splats to triangle face of mesh for differentiable optimization of both the texture and mesh vertices.
papers.title: DreamMesh4D: Video-to-4D Generation with Sparse-Controlled Gaussian-Mesh Hybrid Representation

key_contributions: To tackle the dynamic contents and the occlusions in complex scenes, the paper presents a space-time 2D Gaussian Splatting approach.

Specifically, to improve geometric quality in dynamic scenes, the method learns canonical 2D Gaussian splats and deform these 2D Gaussian splats while enforcing the disks of the Gaussian located on the surface of the objects.

Experiments on real-world sparse-view video datasets and monocular dynamic datasets demonstrate that the reconstructions outperform state-of-the-art methods, especially for the surface of the details.
papers.title: Space-time 2D Gaussian Splatting for Accurate Surface Reconstruction under Complex Dynamic Scenes

key_contributions: Rearranges dynamic Gaussian attributes as multi-channel 2D video so standard hardware video codecs can stream them to mobile devices.
Uses hash-encoded motion, Gaussian pruning, and entropy-temporal refinement to disentangle motion and appearance while reducing storage.
Provides multi-platform players that decode and render streamed volumetric video on common devices.
papers.title: V^3: Viewing Volumetric Videos on Mobiles via Streamable 2D Dynamic Gaussians

key_contributions: To address the issue, the paper proposes an optimization strategy that effectively regularizes splat features by modeling them as the outputs of a corresponding implicit neural field.
The approach effectively handles static and dynamic cases, as demonstrated by extensive testing across different setups and scene complexities.
This results in a consistent enhancement of reconstruction quality across various scenarios.
papers.title: SplatFields: Neural Gaussian Splats for Sparse 3D and 4D Reconstruction

key_contributions: Presents a novel Gaussian-based approach, dubbed DualGS, for real-time and high-fidelity playback of complex human performance with excellent compression ratios.
Subsequently, the method employs a coarse-to-fine training strategy for frame-by-frame human performance modeling.
The approach achieves a compression ratio of up to 120 times, only requiring approximately 350KB of storage per frame.
papers.title: Robust Dual Gaussian Splatting for Immersive Human-centric Volumetric Videos

key_contributions: This paper introduces SwinGS, a novel framework for training, delivering, and rendering volumetric video in a real-time streaming fashion.

Experimental results show that SwinGS reduces transmission costs by 83.6% compared to previous work and could be easily scaled to volumetric videos with arbitrary length with no increasing of required GPU resources.

To address the aforementioned challenges and enhance streamability, SwinGS integrates spacetime Gaussian with Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to adapt the model to fit various 3D scenes across frames, in the meantime employing a sliding.
papers.title: SwinGS: Sliding Window Gaussian Splatting for Volumetric Video Streaming with Arbitrary Length

key_contributions: To this end, the paper proposes a learnable mask strategy that significantly reduces the number of Gaussians while preserving high performance.
In addition, the paper proposes a compact but effective representation of view-dependent color by employing a grid-based neural field rather than relying on spherical harmonics.
Finally, the method learns codebooks to compactly represent the geometric and temporal attributes by residual vector quantization.
papers.title: Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting for Static and Dynamic Radiance Fields

key_contributions: Builds a whole-body avatar from a short monocular video by combining SMPL-X mesh topology with 3D Gaussians.
Associates Gaussians with mesh connectivity so SMPL-X expression parameters drive novel facial expressions.
Uses connectivity-based regularizers to reduce artifacts under novel expressions and poses.
papers.title: Expressive Whole-Body 3D Gaussian Avatar

key_contributions: Proposes a novel strategy for dynamic surgical neural scene registration.
Lastly, the paper presents a novel strategy of deformable scene registration to register two dynamic scenes.
Firsts utilize 4D Gaussian Splatting to represent the surgical scene and capture both static and dynamic scenes effectively.
papers.title: Registering Neural 4D Gaussians for Endoscopic Surgery

key_contributions: Reconstructs generic dynamic scenes with explicit persistent 3D motion trajectories from casually captured monocular video.
Represents motion using a compact set of SE(3) motion bases, allowing soft decomposition into rigidly moving groups.
Consolidates monocular-depth and long-range 2D-track priors into a globally consistent dynamic representation.
papers.title: Shape of Motion: 4D Reconstruction from a Single Video

key_contributions: Introduces a 4D-Gaussian framework for segmenting objects in dynamic 4D representations.
Uses a temporal identity feature field to learn identity features despite Gaussian drift and noisy sparse input.
Adds 4D segmentation refinement to remove artifacts and supports mask-based removal, recoloring, composition, and rendering.
papers.title: Segment Any 4D Gaussians

key_contributions: To this end, the paper introduces EgoGaussian, the first method capable of simultaneously reconstructing 3D scenes and dynamically tracking 3D object motion from RGB egocentric input alone.
Leverages the uniquely discrete nature of Gaussian Splatting and segment dynamic interactions from the background, with both having explicit representations.

The approach employs a clip-level online learning pipeline that leverages the dynamic nature of human activities, allowing us to reconstruct the temporal evolution of the scene in chronological order and track rigid object motion.
papers.title: EgoGaussian: Dynamic Scene Understanding from Egocentric Video with 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Introduces a large reconstruction model that produces animated objects from single-view video in one feed-forward pass.
Builds a curated multiview animated-object training dataset derived from Objaverse assets.
Extends LGM with temporal self-attention and an interpolation model to produce temporally smoother per-frame Gaussian representations.
papers.title: L4GM: Large 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model

key_contributions: Groups explicit 3D Gaussians with similar rotation, translation, and position into shared superpoints.

Specifically, the framework first employs explicit 3D Gaussians to reconstruct the scene and then clusters Gaussians with similar properties (e.g., rotation, translation, and location) into superpoints.
Extensive experiments demonstrate the practicality and effectiveness of the approach on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.title: Superpoint Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time High-Fidelity Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

key_contributions: Learns video motion priors with RMD-Net to refine mesh deformation.
Models relative displacement between the mesh and Gaussians with RGD-Net.
Extensive experiments on the D-NeRF, DG-Mesh, and PeopleSnapshot datasets demonstrate that MaGS achieves state-of-the-art performance in both reconstruction and simulation.
papers.title: MaGS: Reconstructing and Simulating Dynamic 3D Objects with Mesh-adsorbed Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Proposes a novel approach that learns a high-fidelity 4D GS scene representation with self-calibration of camera parameters.
Demonstrates the accuracy and time efficiency of the method through extensive quantitative and qualitative experimental results on several standard benchmarks.
The results show significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods for 4D novel view synthesis.
papers.title: Self-Calibrating 4D Novel View Synthesis from Monocular Videos Using Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: To simplify this process, the paper proposes Topo4D, a novel framework for automatic geometry and texture generation, which optimizes densely aligned 4D heads and 8K texture maps directly from calibrated multi-view time-series images.
Specifically, the method firsts represent the time-series faces as a set of dynamic 3D Gaussians with fixed topology in which the Gaussian centers are bound to the mesh vertices.
Extensive experiments show that the method achieves superior results than the current SOTA face reconstruction methods both in the quality of meshes and textures.
papers.title: Topo4D: Topology-Preserving Gaussian Splatting for High-Fidelity 4D Head Capture

key_contributions: Uses single-view depth estimation to guide dynamic-scene learning from casually captured monocular video.
Introduces a 3D-aware initialization to learn a reasonable deformation field.
Adds a robust depth loss to guide dynamic-scene geometry learning.
papers.title: MoDGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Casually-captured Monocular Videos with Depth Priors

key_contributions: Distills 2D foundation-model features into a dynamic 3D Gaussian representation that jointly stores appearance, geometry, and per-Gaussian semantics.
Jointly optimizes color and semantic attributes so semantic supervision also improves the scene geometry.
Enables prompt- or click-driven dynamic 3D segmentation, dense object tracking, and semantic editing with fast rendering.
papers.title: DGD: Dynamic 3D Gaussians Distillation

key_contributions: Subsequently, the paper introduces a learnable denoising mask coupled with denoising loss to eliminate noise points from the scene, thereby further compressing 3D Gaussian model.

Firstly, the method uses a deformable multi-layer perceptron (MLP) network to capture the dynamic offset of Gaussian points and express the color features of points through hash encoding and a tiny MLP to reduce storage.

Experimental results demonstrate that the method surpasses existing approaches in rendering quality and speed, while significantly reducing the memory usage associated with 3D-GS, making it highly suitable for various tasks such as novel view synthesis.
papers.title: A Refined 3D Gaussian Representation for High-Quality Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

key_contributions: Proposes HFGS, a novel approach for deformable endoscopic reconstruction that addresses these challenges from spatial and temporal frequency perspectives.

Additionally, the paper introduces Temporal High-Frequency Emphasis Reconstruction (THF) to enhance dynamic awareness in neural rendering by leveraging flow priors, focusing optimization on motion-intensive parts.
Extensive experiments on two widely used benchmarks demonstrate that HFGS achieves superior rendering quality.
papers.title: HFGS: 4D Gaussian Splatting with Emphasis on Spatial and Temporal High-Frequency Components for Endoscopic Scene Reconstruction

key_contributions: Introduces 4D Motion Scaffolds, a compact and smooth representation of motion and deformation for casual monocular video.
Disentangles geometry and appearance from deformation by globally fusing Gaussians anchored to the motion scaffold.
Solves focal length and camera poses through bundle adjustment without external pose-estimation tools.
papers.title: MoSca: Dynamic Gaussian Fusion from Casual Videos via 4D Motion Scaffolds

key_contributions: Trains in 40 minutes and renders audio-driven talking faces at 125 FPS from a short person-specific video.
Uses an audio-driven Gaussian deformation field with multi-resolution hash-grid tri-planes and temporal smoothing.

Extensive experiments in person-specific videos with audio tracks validate that GSTalker can generate high-fidelity and audio-lips synchronized results with fast training and real-time rendering speed.
papers.title: GSTalker: Real-time Audio-Driven Talking Face Generation via Deformable Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Introduces a Gaussians-on-Mesh representation that combines splatting with deformable mesh geometry for animatable humans from monocular video.
Supports novel-pose animation and novel-view rasterization-compatible rendering.
Targets memory-efficient real-time avatars through a compact hybrid representation.
papers.title: GoMAvatar: Efficient Animatable Human Modeling from Monocular Video Using Gaussians-on-Mesh

key_contributions: Conditions Gaussian deformation on explicit 3D geometry rather than learning motion solely from image-space reconstruction loss.
Combines positional features with local geometry extracted by a 3D U-Net to encode spatial context.
Improves geometric coherence and rendering quality for deforming multi-view scenes.
papers.title: 3D Geometry-aware Deformable Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic View Synthesis

key_contributions: Assigns learnable embeddings to individual Gaussians so deformation can vary between nearby primitives with different motion.
Uses coarse and fine deformation branches to capture both slow large-scale movement and fast local detail.
Adds local smoothness constraints to retain spatial coherence without suppressing distinct motions.
papers.title: Per-Gaussian Embedding-Based Deformation for Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Combines a textured SMPL-X mesh with Gaussians placed only where mesh rendering is insufficient, such as hair and out-of-mesh clothing.
Uses the hybrid representation to animate highly articulated full-body avatars, including fingers, from monocular video.
Reduces Gaussian count while retaining high-fidelity novel-pose rendering.
papers.title: HAHA: Highly Articulated Gaussian Human Avatars with Textured Mesh Prior

key_contributions: To overcome these limitations, the paper proposes TOGS, a Gaussian splatting method with opacity offset over time, which can effectively improve the rendering quality and speed of 4D DSA.

Introduces an opacity offset table for each Gaussian to model the opacity offsets of the Gaussian, using these opacity-varying Gaussians to model the temporal variations in the radiance of the contrast agent.
By interpolating the opacity offset table, the opacity variation of the Gaussian at different time points can be determined.
papers.title: TOGS: Gaussian Splatting with Temporal Opacity Offset for Real-Time 4D DSA Rendering

key_contributions: Initializes 4D generation with multi-view diffusion applied to input video frames and anchors temporal self-attention to the first frame for consistency.
Optimizes a dynamic Gaussian point cloud with score distillation and an adaptive densification strategy designed to stabilize Gaussian gradients.
Accepts text, image, or video inputs without training or fine-tuning the underlying diffusion networks.
papers.title: STAG4D: Spatial-Temporal Anchored Generative 4D Gaussians

key_contributions: Introduces Gaussian flow, connecting 3D Gaussian dynamics to pixel velocities between consecutive frames.
Obtains Gaussian flow by splatting Gaussian dynamics into image space, enabling direct optical-flow dynamic supervision.
Targets 4D generation and novel-view synthesis, including reduced color drifting in 4D generation.
papers.title: GaussianFlow: Splatting Gaussian Dynamics for 4D Content Creation

key_contributions: Converts dense Gaussian correspondences into optical flow so learned 3D motion can be constrained by 2D observations.
Augments flow supervision with uncertainty handling and coordinated photometric and motion losses.
Uses an auxiliary transient-aware deformation pathway to improve reconstruction of rapidly changing content.
papers.title: Motion-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

key_contributions: Proposes a dynamic Gaussian Splatting method named ManiGaussian for multi-task robotic manipulation, which mines scene dynamics via future scene reconstruction.

Specifically, the method firsts formulate the dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework that infers the semantics propagation in the Gaussian embedding space, where the semantic representation is leveraged to predict the optimal robot action.

Then, the method builds a Gaussian world model to parameterize the distribution in the dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework, which provides informative supervision in the interactive environment via future scene reconstruction.
papers.title: ManiGaussian: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Multi-task Robotic Manipulation

key_contributions: Embeds Gaussian splats on a triangle mesh using barycentric coordinates and displacement to create a hybrid human representation.
Uses mesh-controlled Gaussian transformations instead of an MLP skinning field, supporting skeletal animation, blend shapes, and mesh editing.
Disentangles low-frequency mesh motion from high-frequency Gaussian geometry and appearance.
papers.title: SplattingAvatar: Realistic Real-Time Human Avatars with Mesh-Embedded Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Uses a compact Neural Transformation Cache to predict per-frame Gaussian translations and rotations instead of independently optimizing every primitive.
Adds Gaussians adaptively for newly appearing content while carrying the transformed representation forward through the stream.
Reports approximately 12-second per-frame reconstruction and 200 FPS rendering for multi-view free-viewpoint video.
papers.title: 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos

key_contributions: Enables interactive deformation directly on Gaussian-splatting scenes.

Based on this representation, the method introduces a large-scale Gaussian deformation technique to enable deformable GS, which alters the parameters of 3D Gaussians according to the manipulation of the associated mesh.
Extensive experiments show that the approach achieves high-quality reconstruction and effective deformation, while maintaining the promising rendering results at a high frame rate(65 FPS on average).
papers.title: Mesh-based Gaussian Splatting for Real-time Large-scale Deformation

key_contributions: Represents dynamic content with anisotropic Gaussians directly in XYZT spacetime rather than deforming a canonical 3D cloud.
Parameterizes spatiotemporal rotations with rotors and slices 4D primitives into time-conditioned 3D Gaussians.
Captures complex motion in an explicit representation compatible with efficient real-time splatting.
papers.title: 4D-Rotor Gaussian Splatting: Towards Efficient Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Scenes

key_contributions: Combines a two-level embedding with deformable-body simulation for real-time physics-aware interaction in VR.

The components of the Virtual Reality system are designed for high efficiency and effectiveness, starting from detailed scene reconstruction and object segmentation, advancing through multi-view image in-painting, and extending to interactive physics-based editing.
The system also incorporates real-time deformation embedding and dynamic shadow casting, ensuring a comprehensive and engaging virtual experience.
papers.title: VR-GS: A Physical Dynamics-Aware Interactive Gaussian Splatting System in Virtual Reality

key_contributions: Applies deformable Gaussian splatting to monocular endoscopic tissue reconstruction.
Combines deformation fields, depth-guided spatiotemporal masks, and surface-aligned regularization to handle tool occlusion and recover tissue geometry.
Experiments on DaVinci robotic surgery videos demonstrate that EndoGS achieves superior rendering quality.
papers.title: EndoGS: Deformable Endoscopic Tissues Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Proposes a novel clothed human reconstruction method called GaussianBody, based on 3D Gaussian Splatting.
Uses pose-guided deformation and transformation regularization to associate Gaussians between canonical and observation spaces.
Compared with the costly neural radiance based models, 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently demonstrated great performance in terms of training time and rendering quality.
papers.title: GaussianBody: Clothed Human Reconstruction via 3d Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Models static backgrounds and moving vehicles as separate semantic Gaussian components in an urban scene.
Jointly optimizes tracked object poses and time-varying appearance to improve dynamic driving-scene reconstruction.
Supports real-time rendering and compositional manipulation such as adding, removing, or rearranging vehicles.
papers.title: Street Gaussians: Modeling Dynamic Urban Scenes with Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Builds image-to-4D content by generating a static Gaussian model with DreamGaussianHD and then optimizing HexPlane-driven Gaussian deformation.
Refines UV-space texture maps with a pretrained image-to-video diffusion model to improve detail and temporal consistency.
Reduces per-asset optimization to minutes, supports visual motion control, and exports animated meshes for conventional 3D engines.
papers.title: DreamGaussian4D: Generative 4D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Extends 3D Gaussians with temporal opacity and parametric motion and rotation to represent static, dynamic, and transient content.
Uses splatted neural features instead of spherical harmonics for view- and time-dependent appearance.
Samples new Gaussians using training error and coarse-depth guidance in difficult regions.
papers.title: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic View Synthesis

key_contributions: Introduces ParDy-Human, a fully explicit avatar representation that can be learned from as little as one monocular sequence without human masks or other auxiliary annotations.
Deforms canonical Gaussians first from SMPL vertices, then predicts joint-conditioned per-Gaussian refinements for motion beyond the body model.
Supports variable training backgrounds and efficient full-resolution inference on consumer hardware.
papers.title: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Human Avatars

key_contributions: Decomposes dynamic-scene motion and appearance into sparse control points and dense Gaussians.
Learns compact 6-DoF transformation bases that are interpolated locally to produce Gaussian motion fields.
Adapts control-point locations and counts and applies an ARAP loss for spatial continuity and local rigidity.
papers.title: SC-GS: Sparse-Controlled Gaussian Splatting for Editable Dynamic Scenes

key_contributions: Splits long dynamic sequences into sliding temporal windows, each with a compact canonical Gaussian model and deformation network.
Adapts window duration to scene complexity so the method can scale to arbitrarily long videos.
Fine-tunes neighboring windows for cross-window consistency while preserving real-time rendering.
papers.title: SWinGS: Sliding Windows for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Reconstructs animatable clothed-human avatars from monocular video using deformable 3D Gaussian primitives.
Regularizes non-rigid deformation with an as-isometric-as-possible constraint to preserve local surface structure.
Provides fast subject-specific training and real-time novel-pose rendering.
papers.title: 3DGS-Avatar: Animatable Avatars via Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Reconstructs a large static street background incrementally to manage surrounding multi-camera driving sequences.
Represents moving objects with a composite dynamic Gaussian graph rather than mixing them into the background.
Uses LiDAR priors and panoramic consistency constraints for controllable, high-fidelity driving-scene synthesis.
papers.title: DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes

key_contributions: Attaches animatable Gaussians to a deformable character model for controllable, photorealistic rendering of clothed humans.
Learns Gaussian geometry and appearance in 2D texture space with convolutional networks instead of optimizing every parameter directly in 3D.
Supports real-time novel-view rendering and skeletal motion retargeting while retaining pose-dependent clothing detail.
papers.title: ASH: Animatable Gaussian Splats for Efficient and Photoreal Human Rendering

key_contributions: Combines Gaussian splatting with non-rigid tracking through a coarse deformation graph and fine Gaussian graph.
Optimizes a 4D Gaussian representation with adaptive spatial-temporal regularization for dense human-performance footage.
Introduces residual-compensated compression for compact playback-oriented representations.
papers.title: HiFi4G: High-Fidelity Human Performance Rendering via Compact Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Introduces a dual-domain deformation model for per-Gaussian attribute deformations.
Models time-dependent attribute residuals with polynomial fitting in time and Fourier-series fitting in frequency.
Uses explicit deformation of discretized Gaussian points for dynamic reconstruction from multi-view and monocular video.
papers.title: Gaussian-Flow: 4D Reconstruction with Dynamic 3D Gaussian Particle

key_contributions: Transforms canonical Gaussians into posed space with linear blend skinning while jointly refining pose and skinning weights.
Uses human-prior initialization and structure-aware split, clone, merge, and pruning operations for efficient optimization.
Achieves minute-scale training and high-frame-rate free-viewpoint rendering from a monocular video.
papers.title: GauHuman: Articulated Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Human Videos

key_contributions: Builds an animatable head avatar by augmenting explicit 3D Gaussian splats with a learned latent feature basis.
Linearly blends the latent basis with low-dimensional parametric-head controls to produce expression-dependent Gaussian color and opacity.
Achieves real-time inference while reporting more than a tenfold rendering-speed improvement over prior baselines.
papers.title: HeadGaS: Real-Time Animatable Head Avatars via 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Introduces animatable explicit 3D Gaussians for human appearance across poses and clothing styles from a single video.
Models pose-dependent appearance using a dynamic appearance network and optimizable feature tensor.
Jointly optimizes motion and appearance through differentiable motion conditioning to address inaccurate monocular motion estimates.
papers.title: GaussianAvatar: Towards Realistic Human Avatar Modeling from a Single Video via Animatable 3D Gaussians

key_contributions: Rigs dynamic 3D Gaussian splats to a parametric morphable face model for controllable pose and expression animation.
Parameterizes splats in triangle-local coordinate frames with learned displacement offsets.
Jointly optimizes facial-model and Gaussian parameters for end-to-end avatar reconstruction and reenactment.
papers.title: GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians

key_contributions: Factorizes Gaussian motion into a small set of global basis trajectories and per-Gaussian combination coefficients.
Uses sparsity to disentangle independently moving regions without requiring object-level supervision.
Provides efficient training and real-time rendering while exposing trajectories useful for point tracking.
papers.title: DynMF: Neural Motion Factorization for Real-time Dynamic View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Learns a static scene and fully animatable human avatar from a short monocular video using 3D Gaussian splatting.
Initializes human Gaussians with SMPL and permits deviations for clothing and hair details.
Jointly optimizes skinning weights to coordinate Gaussian articulation for novel-pose synthesis.
papers.title: HUGS: Human Gaussian Splats

key_contributions: Represents the human body with canonical-space Gaussians learned end-to-end from multi-view observations.
Deforms the representation with coarse forward skinning followed by local non-rigid refinement.
Targets real-time novel-pose rendering of clothed-body avatars.
papers.title: Human Gaussian Splatting: Real-time Rendering of Animatable Avatars

key_contributions: Uses a mixture of moving 3D Gaussians to explicitly model articulated, non-rigid subjects from monocular video.
Combines a category template such as SMPL or SMAL with learnable forward skinning and latent bones for complex deformation.
Enables reconstruction in seconds or minutes and fast novel-pose rendering.
papers.title: GART: Gaussian Articulated Template Models

key_contributions: Parameterizes an animatable template with front and back canonical Gaussian maps, allowing CNN-based pose-dependent appearance prediction.
Uses an adaptive garment-aware template and pose projection for novel-pose generalization.
Introduces physically based rendering to decompose material properties and environment illumination for relighting.
papers.title: Animatable and Relightable Gaussians for High-fidelity Human Avatar Modeling

key_contributions: Models Gaussian positions and rotations as compact functions of time while keeping scale, color, and opacity invariant.
Reduces representation memory and relaxes the dense multi-view observation requirement of per-timestep dynamic Gaussians.
Supports monocular and multi-view reconstruction while reporting 118 FPS at 1,352 by 1,014 resolution on a single GPU.
papers.title: A Compact Dynamic 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Dynamic View Synthesis

key_contributions: Represents a human with canonical 3D Gaussians whose articulation extends SMPL forward skinning to arbitrary canonical-space locations.
Introduces a pose-dependent SE(3) field that controls both Gaussian positions and anisotropy.
Uses a neural color field for color regularization and 3D supervision of Gaussian placement.
papers.title: SplatArmor: Articulated Gaussian splatting for animatable humans from monocular RGB videos

key_contributions: Embeds 3D Gaussian primitives in tetrahedral cages, using deformation gradients to transform their orientation and kernels.
Decouples low-dimensional driving signals from Gaussian primitives through localized cage deformation and learned vertex offsets.
Composes independently driven avatar layers, such as garments, hands, and face.
papers.title: Drivable 3D Gaussian Avatars

key_contributions: The approach leverages semantic segmentation masks to focus on the infant, significantly improving the initialization of the scene.
Uses the reconstructed dynamic Gaussians for novel-view rendering and infant-motion tracking.
This work paves the way for advanced movement analysis tools that can be applied to diverse clinical populations, with a particular emphasis on early detection in infants.
papers.title: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Markerless Motion Capture can Reconstruct Infants Movements

key_contributions: Proposes a 4D point-cloud representation built on a 4D feature grid and compatible with hardware rasterization.
Introduces a hybrid appearance model to improve rendering quality while preserving efficiency.
Uses differentiable depth peeling to learn the representation from RGB videos.
papers.title: 4K4D: Real-Time 4D View Synthesis at 4K Resolution

key_contributions: Approximates a dynamic scene's spatiotemporal 4D volume with optimized 4D primitives having explicit geometry and appearance.
Parameterizes 4D Gaussians with anisotropic ellipses that rotate in space and time.
Models view-dependent, time-evolved appearance with coefficients of 4D spherical harmonics.
papers.title: Real-time Photorealistic Dynamic Scene Representation and Rendering with 4D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Proposes a holistic dynamic-scene representation combining 3D Gaussians with 4D neural voxels.
Uses decomposed neural voxel encoding to construct Gaussian features from 4D neural voxels.
Uses a lightweight MLP to predict Gaussian deformations at novel timestamps.
papers.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering

key_contributions: Learns 3D Gaussians in canonical space with a deformation field for monocular dynamic-scene reconstruction.
Introduces annealing smoothing during training to reduce the effect of inaccurate poses on time interpolation.
Uses a differential Gaussian rasterizer for high-quality, real-time dynamic rendering.
papers.title: Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

key_contributions: Jointly performs dynamic novel-view synthesis and dense 6-DoF tracking of scene elements.
Allows Gaussians to move and rotate while enforcing persistent color, opacity, and size over time.
Regularizes motion and rotation with local-rigidity constraints, yielding persistent dynamic view synthesis without correspondence or flow input.
papers.title: Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis

key_contributions: Introduces a large-scale human-performance repository with more than 1,500 subjects, 5,000 motion sequences, and 67.5 million frames.
Provides multi-view imagery, videos, keypoints, masks, SMPL-X models, and clothing or accessory assets.
Defines a quantitative benchmark for novel-view, novel-pose, and novel-identity rendering.
papers.title: DNA-Rendering: A Diverse Neural Actor Repository for High-Fidelity Human-centric Rendering

key_contributions: Introduces ActorsHQ: 12-megapixel multi-view footage from 160 cameras for 16 human-motion sequences with per-frame meshes.
Presents HumanRF, a temporally factorized 4D neural representation for high-fidelity, compressed human-performance playback.
Addresses long sequences and high-resolution dynamic human view synthesis.
papers.title: HumanRF: High-Fidelity Neural Radiance Fields for Humans in Motion

key_contributions: Identifies multi-view signal leakage in dynamic-view-synthesis evaluation and defines effective multi-view factors for capture sequences.
Introduces co-visibility-masked image metrics and correspondence accuracy for evaluation.
Releases an iPhone dataset with diverse real-world deformation sequences.
papers.title: Monocular Dynamic View Synthesis: A Reality Check

key_contributions: Introduces ENeRF, which builds cascade cost volumes from multi-view images to predict coarse geometry.
Samples near predicted surfaces to reduce empty-space evaluation for interactive free-viewpoint video.
Jointly learns depth prediction and radiance fields from RGB observations.
papers.title: Efficient Neural Radiance Fields for Interactive Free-viewpoint Video

key_contributions: Models topologically varying dynamic scenes by lifting a NeRF into a higher-dimensional hyperspace.
Represents each observed configuration as a slice through a 5D radiance field, avoiding discontinuous deformation mappings.
Evaluates moment interpolation and fixed-moment novel-view synthesis.
papers.title: HyperNeRF: A Higher-Dimensional Representation for Topologically Varying Neural Radiance Fields

key_contributions: Represents dynamic multi-view video with a time-conditioned NeRF and compact latent codes.
Uses hierarchical training and ray importance sampling to improve training speed and perceptual quality.
Provides a compact representation for novel-view synthesis and motion interpolation of 3D video.
papers.title: Neural 3D Video Synthesis from Multi-view Video

key_contributions: Introduces a deformable-mesh-anchored latent representation that integrates observations across video frames for sparse-view human synthesis.
Releases ZJU-MoCap, a multi-view dataset of performers with complex motions.
Also demonstrates monocular reconstruction on People-Snapshot.
papers.title: Neural Body: Implicit Neural Representations with Structured Latent Codes for Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Humans

key_contributions: Extends NeRF to dynamic scenes by making time an input and learning canonicalization and time-specific deformation mappings.
Reconstructs rigid, articulated, and non-rigid motion from a moving monocular camera.
Releases dynamic scenes and reference code for time-controllable novel-view rendering.
papers.title: D-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes

key_contributions: Models casually captured deformable scenes with a continuous volumetric deformation field into a canonical 5D NeRF.
Introduces coarse-to-fine coordinate optimization and elastic deformation regularization for robust learning.
Collects time-synchronized dual-phone data to evaluate unseen-view rendering.
papers.title: Nerfies: Deformable Neural Radiance Fields

review_basis: Official arXiv or venue records and abstracts, author project pages, implementation-bearing public repositories, lexical, citation, source, project, and venue discovery audits, and a task-first agentic leading-category review.

key_contributions: Augments dynamic Gaussian primitives with convex hulls to represent hard surfaces and complex object boundaries from sparse monocular input.
Uses optical-flow-guided edge consistency to align Gaussian distributions with object contours.
Extends temporal regularization to continuous unit intervals and applies coarse-to-fine optimization for stable real-time rendering.
venue_only_papers.title: Edge Consistency for 4D Gaussian Splatting in Dynamic Scene Rendering

key_contributions: Introduces geometry-aware normal constraints that preserve consistency while dynamic Gaussian objects deform.
Uses diffusion-model latent regularization to improve cross-view consistency from monocular input, including reflective materials.
Improves dynamic-scene geometry and rendering quality while retaining real-time rendering.
venue_only_papers.title: NVC-GS: Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction via Normal-Regularized and Multi-View-Consistent 3D Gaussian Splatting

key_contributions: Introduces Inter-PLAS to produce spatially smooth Gaussian attribute maps while improving correspondence between I- and P-frames.
Organizes Gaussian sequences into groups of pictures and encodes high-bit-depth attribute maps with conventional video codecs.
Evaluates the codec on tracked and semi-tracked Gaussian sequences against MPEG video- and point-cloud-based anchors.
venue_only_papers.title: GSCV: Compressing Gaussian Splatting Sequence with Video Codec

key_contributions: Introduces a spatial-temporal 4D Gaussian representation for high-quality real-time dynamic-scene rendering.
Uses motion-aware shape regularization to preserve coherent Gaussian geometry across time.
Applies joint spatial-temporal density control to allocate primitives efficiently in dynamic regions.
venue_only_papers.title: ST-4DGS: Spatial-Temporally Consistent 4D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Dynamic Scene Rendering
